steps.en: Date and time paid is stored with every payment
steps.id: Tanggal dan jam bayar tersimpan untuk setiap pembayaran

steps.en: Payment time is compared with the escalation time
steps.id: Waktu bayar dibandingkan dengan waktu escalation
steps.why_en: No comparison of the payment time against the escalation time exists anywhere.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada pembandingan waktu bayar dengan waktu escalation di mana pun.

steps.en: OCMS decides paid status from that time comparison
steps.id: OCMS memutuskan status paid dari perbandingan waktu itu
steps.why_en: The paid decision looks only at the amount, never at when the payment was made.
steps.why_id: Keputusan lunas hanya melihat jumlah uang, tidak melihat kapan pembayaran dilakukan.

steps.en: A $40 payment before the $55 escalation is recorded as fully paid
steps.id: Bayar $40 sebelum naik ke $55 dicatat sebagai lunas
steps.why_en: Such a payment is recorded as a partial payment, not as fully paid.
steps.why_id: Pembayaran seperti itu dicatat sebagai bayar sebagian, bukan lunas.

steps.en: No manual reduction is needed for the payment to be updated
steps.id: Tidak perlu pengurangan amount manual agar pembayaran ter-update
steps.why_en: The amount still has to be corrected by hand before the payment counts.
steps.why_id: Jumlah tetap harus dikoreksi manual sebelum pembayaran dianggap masuk.
